Items to be checked
Complete system installation accepted by Aker Kvaerner Chemetics Field Supervisor. (See signed Contractor Field Check List)
Condition of paint work.
Accessibility:  make certain all clearances have been maintained and removal of circuit breakers etc., is possible.
Dust and vermin proofing.
Labelling: correct and meets specifications.
Bus bar joints check for torqued indication ().
Check electrical clearances inside switchgear.
Check terminations.
Check special tools for availability and operation.
Check manual operation of draw-out mechanism.
Check raising and lowering of truck gear.
Check mechanical interlocks and shutters for proper operation
Check electrical interlocks and auxiliary contacts used for status indication.
Check grounding devices.
Check potential transformers for correct ratio and sizing and draw-out operation (including fuses).
Check current transformers for correct ratio and sizing (both metering and protection CT’s).
Check protection relays for proper operation by secondary injection.
Check time settings by secondary injection.
Check resetting of relays.
Check contact functions.
Check operation of auxiliary relays.
Check metering (A, V, Hz, etc) by applying primary and/or secondary sources.
Check station batteries.
Check operation of battery charger and its alarms.
Check all fuses, mini C/B’s, switches, push buttons and test blocks
Check phase sequence on incoming feeder(s).
Megger test equipment (use 2500/5000 V megger) list results.
Hi Pot test if customer requires.
System ready for water batching
